_comment: Repro for Eyevinn/channel-engine#325 / #384. The exact channel-engine session config.subtitleTracks used against master.m3u8 (whose SUBTITLES media tag has NAME="French" but NO LANGUAGE attribute). channel-engine forwards this to @eyevinn/hls-vodtolive as expectedSubtitleTracks (engine/session.ts _tickAsync, hlsOpts ~line 1341). Session started with useVTTSubtitles/use_vtt_subtitles enabled.

matchingName._comment: config name equals the manifest NAME -> real cues served today (NAME fallback works on @eyevinn/hls-vodtolive@4.1.10). Evidence: evidence_real_cues_name_match.m3u8

mismatchedName._comment: config name differs from the manifest NAME and there is no LANGUAGE to fall back on -> matching fails, only dummy vtt segments served (the residual #325 bug). Evidence: evidence_dummy_segments_name_mismatch.m3u8
